Be mindful: radmanso drawers will be placed on the wall opposite the bed. show me layout in browser. Use amazon only for searches. Be a interior designer, make sure color,lenght etc work" IKEA sells three RÅDMANSÖ dressers in brown walnut effect, all 18 7/8" deep: the 6-drawer (ikea-40593839, 62 5/8" wide, 31 7/8" tall, $349.99), the 3-drawer (ikea-80593837, 35 3/8" wide, 31 3/4" tall, $229.99) and the 5-drawer (ikea-60593838, 27 1/2" wide, 52" tall, $299.99). Which one Andrew means isn't said: the 6-drawer is staged, and the depth, which sets every clearance in front of it, is the same for all three. IKEA was opened only to read these (his words: "Use amazon only for searches"). STAGED in master-bedroom a, h, k: the left wall, opposite the king, rot 270, x 0-18.875, y 35-97.625. The page: "The RÅDMANSÖ series is inspired by mid-century design with sleek lines, great functionality and a warm walnut tone. This wide chest of drawers has 6 generous drawers – and a top that's great for display." and "Designed to meet the US Federal Stability Standard". Article 405.938.39; 3.9 stars (192 reviews). 3 packages: 34 x 18 3/4 x 4 1/2", 65 1/4 x 18 1/2 x 2 1/2", 35 x 16 1/4 x 4 1/2". In stock at IKEA Long Island, NY; home delivery to 11364 from $29.00 (as read). IKEA's photos show brass knobs and black legs (alt text). Status stays candidate until Andrew names the dresser.
